title: Oil Infused Argentinian Flour Tortilla Empanadas
description: A light and floral one-pot Argentinian dish featuring flour tortilla, made in a kadhai vessel with mortar-pestle-pound technique, suitable for ayurvedic tamasic friendly diet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a kadhai vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender.
Add the chopped spinach and cook until it is wilted.
Add the crumbly feta cheese, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and stir well.
Using a mortar and pestle, pound the mixture to create a coarse texture.
Place a spoonful of the mixture onto a flour tortilla and fold it in half to form a triangle.
Cook the empanadas in the kadhai vessel for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy.
